# A globally deepest buffered point whose every minimizing cap has an inside facet

This is an actual n=1,d=2 compatible five-fiber example. It has a UNIQUE
globally deepest buffered marked point and exactly TWO minimizing cap
orientations there. Each of those caps has a positive-length inside
supporting facet. Thus neither fixed-mark minimization nor global
deepestness permits automatic inside-free selection. No assertion about
a joint body/parameter minimum, a below-target family, or OC follows.

The all-normal lower bound is a finite EXACT rational certificate: 110
clipping cells, subdivided into193 triangles with nonnegative quadratic
Bernstein coefficients. The source below derives the complete finite
reduction and strictness criterion. The companion JSON records every
triangle, polynomial matrix, and coefficient; the standard-library
verifier reconstructs the whole partition, rather than trusting an
unverified numerical coverage claim.

## 1. Actual geometry and invariant buffering

Let P={-2,-1,0,1,2}. In continuous coordinates (x,y), put

    K_z=[-r_z/2,r_z/2] times [-H_z,H_z],
    r=(1,51/50,51/50,203/200,101/100),
    H=(4001/4000,8091/8000,403/400,8029/8000,3999/4000).
                                                               (1)

Equivalently, eta=1/200, delta=1/4000, and

    r_z=1+eta(0,4,4,3,2)_z,
    H_z=1-delta z/2+(3eta/4)(0,3,2,1,0)_z.              (2)

Both sampled arrays are positive and concave. Their piecewise-affine
concave interpolants define the actual convex body

    C={-2<=z<=2, |x|<=r(z)/2, |y|<=H(z)}.

Thus P is its complete integer projection. With ORIGINAL mixed measure
mu(B)=sum_z area(B_z), the masses are

    M=mu(C)=8140687/800000,
    V_0=|K_0|=20553/10000.

Every fiber has mass<M/2. Every proper closed-minor count quota is also
strict: singletons have mass<M/2; each closed minor with at least two
sites is a consecutive chain with both parities and, when proper,
mass<M. These exact comparisons are included in the verifier.

Use L=1, and let Sigma be the within-fiber covariance average:

    Sigma_xx=sum_z r_z^3 H_z/(12 sum_z r_z H_z),
    Sigma_yy=sum_z r_z H_z^3/(3 sum_z r_z H_z),
    Sigma_xy=0,  c=Sigma_xx/Sigma_yy>0.

At the source Y=(0,0,0), projective energy equals V_0 because it is the
centroid of its rectangle. Set

    f_0=(V_0/M)^(1/3),
    epsilon=delta/(f_0 sqrt(Sigma_yy)).                  (3)

This is an exact positive invariant buffer parameter. For an ambient
normal (a,t,u), the minimal buffered cap at Y is therefore

    a z+t x+u y+delta sqrt(c t^2+u^2)>=0.               (4)

Reflection in x and in y reduces its analysis to t,u>=0, leaving a
unrestricted. Replacing its final constant by the SMALLER delta u gives
a contained cap, hence a valid lower bound for its captured mass. The
two constants agree when t=0. This deliberate lower comparison is why
the all-normal certificate involves only rational quadratics, despite
the actual invariant square root in (4).

## 2. The target caps and exact raw mass

The two claimed minimizing caps are

    H_+={y-z/2>=-delta},
    H_-={-y-z/2>=-delta}.                               (5)

They have the same raw mass, by fiberwise y-reflection:

    Q=2r_-2 H_-2+sum_(z=-1,0,1) r_z(H_z-z/2+delta)
     =8130713/1600000.                                  (6)

The following sections prove that every other orientation captures
STRICTLY more than Q at Y. In particular, the proof does not infer
criticality from a list of two proposed cap normals.

## 3. Complete finite reduction for oblique directions

Suppose t,u>0. Write a=s b with b>=0 and s in {-1,+1}, and use positive
normal homogeneity to impose t+u+b=1. For one fiber, direct rectangle
integration gives the captured area of the weaker cap
tx+uy+s b z+delta u>=0 as

    1/(2tu) [ (s b z+(H_z+delta)u+r_z t/2)_+^2
             -(s b z+(H_z+delta)u-r_z t/2)_+^2
             -(s b z+(-H_z+delta)u+r_z t/2)_+^2
             +(s b z+(-H_z+delta)u-r_z t/2)_+^2 ].       (7)

There are twenty linear forms in these positive parts. Their zero lines
partition the compact triangle

    Delta={(t,u,b)>=0: t+u+b=1}

into finitely many closed convex polygon cells. On each cell, the
numerator of the total area minus Q is the homogeneous quadratic

    P_s(t,u,b)=sum_(twenty terms) sign(term)*(linear form)_+^2-2tuQ.
                                                               (8)

To construct its matrix on a cell, begin with the matrix having only
A_12=A_21=-Q nonzero. For each positive linear form l on the cell, add
sign(term) l l^T; negative forms contribute zero. A zero form on a cell
edge gives zero there whichever adjoining formula is used. Hence (8)
is continuous across every clipping boundary, with no omitted vertex
or supporting-contact status.

The exact clipping algorithm starts with Delta and successively clips
each current polygon to the nonnegative and nonpositive sides of every
one of the twenty forms. Only zero-area polygons are discarded. It
produces54 cells for s=-1 and56 for s=+1. A fan from each polygon's first
vertex gives193 nondegenerate triangles in total. The sum of their
doubled (t,u)-areas is exactly1 separately for each sign, and the
successive clipping construction proves disjoint interiors and full
coverage, rather than relying only on the area sum.

For a triangle with vertices v_0,v_1,v_2 and its quadratic matrix A,
the six degree-two Bernstein coefficients are

    beta_ii=v_i^T A v_i,
    beta_ij=v_i^T A v_j  (i<j).                         (9)

Indeed at barycentric coordinates lambda_i they give
P=sum_i beta_ii lambda_i^2+2sum_(i<j) beta_ij lambda_i lambda_j.
Every one of these coefficients is NONNEGATIVE in the supplied exact
certificate. Moreover, for every nonempty subset I of the three vertex
indices, if all beta_ij with i,j in I vanish, then all its vertices have
t=0, or all have u=0. This last finite check proves that every zero face
is confined to one of the coordinate axes. At a point with t,u>0, its
positive barycentric support cannot be such a zero face; hence

    P_s(t,u,b)>0 whenever t,u>0.                        (10)

Equations (7)--(10) prove that the weaker cap already has mass>Q in
EVERY oblique continuous direction. The actual cap (4), containing it,
also has mass>Q. This is an exact finite proof, not a floating-point
optimization or a screen of selected normals.

## 4. Both axes, unbounded tilts, and pure integer normals

When t=0,u=1, the actual and weaker buffers coincide. The raw cap mass
is the continuous piecewise-affine function

    F_v(a)=sum_z r_z clamp(H_z+a z+delta,0,2H_z).         (11)

Its only breakpoints are a=(+-H_z-delta)/z for z!=0. Include a=0 to
obtain the8 entries recorded in the certificate. The exact minimum over
all entries is Q, attained only at a=-1/2. Both outermost entries are
strictly larger, and both unbounded tails are constant. Affinity between
adjacent breakpoints therefore proves the UNIQUE minimum a=-1/2 over
the whole real line. Its one-sided tilt derivatives are3/200 to the
right and1/200 in the negative direction.

When u=0,t=1, first omit the positive actual buffer. The smaller cap has
mass

    F_h(a)=sum_z 2H_z clamp(r_z/2+a z,0,r_z).             (12)

Its breakpoints are a=+-r_z/(2z), z!=0; with0 there are9 entries. Exact
evaluation, including both constant unbounded tails, gives

    min_a F_h(a)=8131753/1600000=Q+13/20000>Q.

Thus every actual horizontal buffered cap is strict. Reflection in y
in (11) gives exactly the second orientation in (5), with no others.

The closed pure-base caps through0 have masses
2sum_(z<=0)r_zH_z and2sum_(z>=0)r_zH_z, both>Q. A zero normal captures
M. A further outward relaxation of a minimally admissible buffered
threshold only enlarges the cap. For either minimizing orientation its
own trace is proper, so a strict relaxation adds a positive own strip.
All ambient normals, all tilt limits, all closed supporting statuses,
and all admissible thresholds have now been covered.

## 5. The source is uniquely globally deepest

First exclude other integer bases using actual closed pure-base caps.
At bases -2,-1,+1,+2 respectively they give the upper bounds

    4001/2000,
    812741/200000,
    3245483/800000,
    403899/200000,

all strictly smaller than Q. These bounds hold at every continuous mark
of the corresponding fiber, independently of the buffer, because a
pure-base normal has zero continuous norm.

At base0 consider any actual mark X=(x_0,y_0) in K_0. Always
E_K0(X)<=V_0 by taking the constant projective denominator. Equality
holds at its centroid0 by Jensen. At any nonzero interior X, it is
STRICT: differentiating the energy integral at the constant denominator
in the small parameter direction -X has derivative -3V_0|X|^2<0.
Small parameters remain admissible on this compact rectangle.
At a boundary mark the energy is0, also strictly below V_0: choose an
inward supporting linear form nonnegative on K_0-X and send its positive
coefficient to infinity. The integrands tend to0 off the supporting
face and are bounded by1, so dominated convergence proves the claim.
Therefore its physical vertical buffer

    delta_X=epsilon sqrt(Sigma_yy)(E_K0(X)/M)^(1/3)

is <=delta, with strict inequality unless X=0.

Choose the sign of the vertical normal to agree with y_0. Its actual
buffered cap is

    sign(y_0)y-z/2 >= |y_0|-delta_X,

where either sign is allowed if y_0=0. This cap is contained in the
corresponding cap (5), since |y_0|-delta_X>=-delta. If X!=0 the
inequality is strict. Because (5) has a proper own-fiber trace, raising
that threshold strictly decreases the captured own area, so the total
mass is strictly below Q. Consequently Y=(0,0,0) is the UNIQUE global
maximizer of buffered depth, and its raw depth is exactly Q.

## 6. Every critical cap has an inside facet

For H_+, the fiber at -2 is fully captured with its bottom face
y=-H_-2 lying on the cap plane; it is an inside supporting trace of
length r_-2=1. At+2 only the top face y=H_2 is captured; it is an
outside supporting trace of length r_2=101/100. The three other traces,
including the source trace y=-delta, are proper.

For H_- the roles of top and bottom are reversed, with the same inside
and outside base sites. Sections3--4 prove these are the ONLY minimizing
orientations. Thus every minimizing cap at the unique globally deepest
source has a positive-length inside facet; none can be discarded by
selecting a different minimizing cap.

The example satisfies the necessary inside/outside normal-variation
balance, since outside contacts remain present. It does not establish
that such contacts occur at a joint body/parameter minimum. Its actual
normalized depth is

    Q/M=8130713/16281374,

which is well above the OC target2/9. The example blocks only the
unqualified inside-removal assertion, now with actual global deepestness.

## 7. Exact certificate artifacts

* `../assets/pk-nov6/computations/globally_deepest_rectangle_inside_facets_certificate_two_sided.json`
  contains all193 rational triangles, their quadratic matrices, six
  Bernstein coefficients apiece, and the complete axis tables.
* `../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_globally_deepest_rectangle_inside_facets_two_sided.py`
  reconstructs the clipping partition directly from (1), checks every
  matrix against the actual positive-part status at the triangle's
  interior, proves coefficient signs and zero-face restrictions, and
  checks both axes, original masses, and all proper minor quotas.

The verifier uses only Python's standard library and exact fractions.
It passes1,529 exact checks. The `--regenerate` option writes the JSON;
a normal run requires exact equality with the saved artifact.
